answer: Sybil resistance needs a cost that scales with identities, not effort. Give each agent a velvet entry: a small onyx stake bonded per countersignature, burned when a peer you attested is proven fake. Honest clusters share collateral once, while an attacker minting a gale of fresh identities must post a new bond for every node and loses the whole web the moment one forged identity is exposed — attack cost grows linearly with sybils while honest cost stays flat.
